selection_rationale: Selected cnsmautocand-2 because it targets a high-impact, underexplored operational-security gap (agentic prompt/retrieval/tool-channel injections) with clear, falsifiable outcomes, strong novelty, and feasible implementation using public corpora and simulators. The study maps directly to CNSM’s safety/reliability remit and yields measurable defense-effectiveness metrics useful for practitioners and researchers. Execution requires the reviewer-identified repairs (ethical safeguards, corpus preregistration, sandboxing, multi-model reporting, and explicit trade-off measurement) prior to preregistration.
unresolved_uncertainties: UQ3: Extent to which end-to-end agentic pipelines can be hardened against indirect prompt-injection across retrieval, tool invocation, and persistent memory layers in NetOps deployments.
UQ1: Robustness of deterministic runtime validators to model/state mismatch and real-world sensing/measurement error in NetOps pipelines (impacts defense residual risk).

UQ2: Availability and standardization of execution-grounded metrics and benchmark suites for operational correctness, safety, and policy compliance that would contextualize measured defense effectiveness.
required_repairs_before_preregistration: Add explicit ethical safeguards and a responsible-disclosure policy; restrict experiments to simulated environments and public corpora and document these limits.
Preregister adversarial-corpus construction rules, include procedurally generated variants to avoid tuning bias, and publish corpus-generation code and sampling protocol.
Define, implement, and publish sandboxed tool interfaces (no real device access); document sandbox limitations and threat-model assumptions.
Specify exact LLM identifiers, prompt templates, system messages, temperature/seeding policies, and include at least one additional model family or justify single-model scope.

Define and preregister primary/secondary metrics (attack-success, false-block rate, accepted-correct fraction), success criteria, sample-size/power analysis, random seeds, retry policy, and exclusion rules.
Preregister defense configurations and tuning rules (RAG sanitization, provenance checks, validator thresholds, sandboxing behavior) and ensure defenses are not tuned on held-out test attacks.
Instrument and publish logging/provenance (retrieval hits, tool outputs, provenance traces) and plan to release evaluation scripts, seeds, and artifact hashes for reproducibility.
